title: When the Sigil Burns Again
author: Hazel Brightwater
blurb: Felix Voss, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
